patterns.why: code orchestrates; the greeting gate is a code check after a typed agent envelope
front-door router with named refusals; non-workflow and forbidden asks never reach an agent
each seat loads its 4 prompt files from disk, so the generated workflow stays editable
the greeting requirement must map to a phase, a named gate and a verifier, not prose
the greeting gate must check the value is a nonempty string, not just sound strong

risks: R10: a single requirement is easy to drop into prose; it needs its own requirements[] row
R1: if the request names a tool outside read/grep/find/ls/write/edit/bash it is a preflight blocker, not a capability

requirement_notes.requirement: gate a greeting is a nonempty string
requirement_notes.coverage: P1/A2: one agent phase, one named gate, one focused verifier
